context.description: Add the run header with the spec title from structured metadata

evidence.trustReason: Re-verification at HEAD 6584f205d4 (fixes 72a3011b16, bee91b3767). Every non-N/A test case has a meaningful assertion and all runs pass. (1) Whole-spec header + metadata (UI6): core-command 'header: a whole-spec run's first message...' asserts the exact parts through TaskCommand.run (text 'Implementing spec **Release notes from conventional commits**', metadata.taskHarness.header {spec{id,title}, leftOut: []}, noReply true, one prompt). (2) Subtree (VF8): 'VF8 a subtree run that leaves scenarios out...' asserts exact parts for T1.1 with header.task and leftOut derived by an independent formula (non-empty); T1.2 text via header(subtree).text toStartWith. (3) Empty H1: header() text 'Implementing spec **release-notes.spec**', metadata keeps title ''; TaskStatus.project run.title = spec id; TUI render shows the id bold. (4) TUI UserMessage (the earlier gap, now closed): bee91b3767 moves the guard and body into task-header.tsx as shows(split) and MessageBody; the new render test proves a header-only message shows and draws the header, header then other texts, nothing for empty or synthetic-only, and header-like text with no metadata stays plain text (closes the earlier 'never parses text' note); TaskHeader render tests prove muted lead-in, bold title in text tone, word wrap without cut, muted Left out line; the route source check pins const split = createMemo(() => splitHeader(props.parts)), <Show when={shows(split())}>, <MessageBody theme={theme} split={split()} /> and rejects <Show when={text()}>. My own scratch-copy mutation sweep (10 mutants of shows, MessageBody, splitHeader and the route UserMessage, incl. all three mutants that survived the first verification): 10 caught. (5) Older header keeps its title: split case reads each message's own part metadata; TaskHeader takes only theme and header. (6) Security: PromptInput text parts have optional metadata (tsgo clean); taskOps forwards parts: input.parts (source check) and session/prompt.test 'a /task header's text part keeps its metadata (T4.10)' passes against the real SessionPrompt; no src/task file imports session/prompt (test scan plus my grep). (7) Concurrency N/A. (8) status.json run.task = {T1.2, Compute the next version} for the subtree, absent for the whole spec. Runs: core-command -t header 5/5; core-command full 50/50 (132.8 s); prompt.test -t T4.10 1/1; fault-folders 7/7; tui test/routes 7/7; tsgo exit 0 in opencode and tui. No regression: T4.11 commits since the first verification do not touch header, headerParts or diedLine.
